scope: Existing eight-round/sixteen-endpoint calibration evidence only; no new capture, experiment, trace or xcresult reads.
source_receipts_and_pngs: Original bytes copied without rewriting. Portable sidecar binds all copied bytes and declared old_study_root. Original capture receipts retain their original artifact hashes and absolute paths.
trace_policy: Only original receipt lossless_trace_storage hash/size declarations retained. Trace archives and xcresults were neither read, copied nor reverified.

observed_fixed_coordinates.note: Coordinates and inset are descriptive fixed-grid results; capsule is a public-carrier approximation, not native optical alpha.

supports: For this baseline and finite encoded +20 stimuli, a single alpha in [0,1] shared by all nine output/input components is incompatible with primary T4 at 49 ROI pixels, including 32 in the prespecified above-rail inset>=1 domain.
Separate alpha per input column remains compatible at T4 everywhere. This keeps input-conditioned spatial responses as a candidate family for further discrimination, not as an identified cause.

The per-output-row family is also compatible in the entire primary domain; two output-R incompatibilities occur only at the 0.35pt rim. Current primary-domain data therefore do not distinguish input-conditioned from output-conditioned families.
All common-kernel incompatibilities disappear by T8; report T1/4/8/16/24 together rather than treating T4 as a universal physical error bound.
does_not_support: No unique channel-dependent displacement, blur kernel, chromatic aberration, physical thickness, native alpha or processing order is identified by this one spatial mask.

Input-column T4 compatibility is not exact equality: input G still has three T1 incompatibilities. The finite encoded-byte contrast can conflate gamma/transfer, local nonlinear/adaptive color, clipping, and mixtures of direct/optical layers.
Zero recorded geometry/control drift improves this comparison but does not convert the diagnostic into optical acceptance or prove parity across backgrounds, sizes, controls or motion.
The changed RGB baseline does not causally repeat the earlier G128 midpoint contrast, and no present result establishes the user-visible sharper colors, edge stretch or rim highlight by itself.
next_model_direction_without_new_capture: Retain separate finite color-response and spatial-response terms as alternative hypotheses; do not hard-code RGB-specific refraction offsets from these values.
Use the current result as a falsification of the shared-alpha encoded-affine simplification, not as a fit target that selects production shader parameters.

A future authorized discriminating study would need multiple independently located masks plus amplitude/baseline controls and prespecified holdouts to separate input-conditioned sampling, output-conditioned processing and encoded nonlinearity. This validation initiates none of those experiments.
